title: Anglo-Iranian Oil Company (AIOC)
snippet: Exclusive concessionaire operating Iran's oil extraction and the Abadan refinery under highly unfavorable royalty agreements for Iran.

title: Halliburton / Kellogg Brown & Root (KBR)
snippet: Primary prime logistics and infrastructure contractor under the US Army Logistics Civil Augmentation Program (LOGCAP III) during the 2003 invasion and occupation of Iraq.

title: Lockheed Martin Corporation
snippet: World's largest defense contractor; primary manufacturer of tactical aircraft, precision-guided missiles, radar systems, and air defense platforms for the US military and foreign military sales allies including Israel.

title: Iran
snippet: Geopolitically critical Middle Eastern nation subject to intense foreign intervention over control of its vast petroleum reserves, strategically vital Persian Gulf coastline, and regional sphere of influence.

title: Iraq
snippet: Mesopotamian state subjected to catastrophic foreign military interventions, including the 1991 Gulf War, twelve years of comprehensive economic sanctions, and the devastating 2003 US-led invasion and occupation.

title: Israel
snippet: State established in 1948 whose military, intelligence, and diplomatic interventions have shaped modern Middle Eastern history, foreign occupations, regional wars, and cross-border operations.

title: Lebanon
snippet: East Mediterranean nation heavily destabilized by regional proxy conflicts, repeated Israeli military invasions (notably 1978, 1982, 1993, 1996, 2006), and prolonged foreign occupations.

title: Palestine
snippet: Territories comprising the West Bank, East Jerusalem, and the Gaza Strip, as well as the global diaspora of millions of Palestinian refugees displaced during successive regional wars.

title: United States
snippet: Primary global superpower following World War II, conducting global military interventions, covert regime change operations, intelligence alliances, and economic sanctions across Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East.

title: The Coup: 1953, the CIA, and the Roots of Modern U.S.-Iranian Relations
snippet: Scholarly reassessment of the 1953 coup arguing that geopolitical control of Iranian petroleum was the primary driving motive rather than Cold War anti-communism alone.

title: The Report of the Iraq Inquiry (The Chilcot Report)
snippet: Massive 2.6-million-word official British government inquiry concluding that the 2003 invasion of Iraq was launched before peaceful options were exhausted, based on flawed intelligence, and without adequate post-conflict planning.

title: Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS), 1951–1954: Iran, 1951–1954 (Retrospective Volume)
snippet: Official declassified documentary record containing internal CIA, State Department, and White House cables explicitly confirming the direct authorization and execution of Operation TPAJAX.

title: Report of the Commission of Inquiry into the Events at the Refugee Camps in Beirut (Kahan Commission)
snippet: Official Israeli judicial inquiry concluding that Defense Minister Ariel Sharon bore personal responsibility for failing to foresee and prevent the massacre after facilitating Phalangist entry into the camps.

title: All the Shah's Men: An American Coup and the Roots of Middle East Terror
snippet: Scholarly and investigative history detailing the planning and execution of Operation Ajax by the CIA and British MI6 to depose Prime Minister Mohammad Mosaddegh.

title: Israel in Lebanon: The Report of the International Commission to Enquire into Reported Violations of International Law by Israel during Its Invasion of Lebanon
snippet: Independent international legal inquiry chaired by Nobel Peace Prize laureate Sean MacBride assessing Israeli legal culpability under the Fourth Geneva Convention during the 1982 invasion and Sabra-Shatila massacre.

title: Report on the U.S. Intelligence Community's Prewar Intelligence Assessments on Iraq
snippet: Official congressional investigation finding that major key judgments in the 2002 National Intelligence Estimate regarding Iraqi weapons of mass destruction were either overstated or unsupported by underlying intelligence reporting.

title: The Iron Wall: Israel and the Arab World
snippet: Authoritative revisionist history by Oxford historian Avi Shlaim examining Israeli military and diplomatic strategies, including the strategic aims and political fallout of the 1982 Lebanon war.

title: A History of Iraq (Third Edition)
snippet: Authoritative academic historical study from Cambridge University Press tracing modern Iraqi state formation, Ba'athist authoritarianism, and the structural disintegration triggered by the 2003 US invasion.
